criteria.criterion: One decidable goal with the scope boundaries stated
Every request item maps to a unit and every unit traces back
Every unit carries a checkable MUST/SHOULD criterion taken from the request
Every MUST criterion names a runnable check; a check the unit creates is declared as its artifact, never assumed to exist
One writer per surface and units ordered by dependency
Unsafe or unresolvable items name the HALT path and the operator question

coverage.basis: all 7 sections and all 6 unit rows re-read against the five round-0 findings; each finding's resolution was checked in the table it touched

findings.evidence: round 1: U2 takes a list and orders rounds by attempt, contiguous from 0
round 1: the verification cell names the runner and declares the test module as a unit artifact
round 1: the composed foreground set must state the gate exactly once
round 1: U5 carries the measured-state and pin refresh as MUST
round 1: the effective-date default and the --since override are named in U2

claims.claim: The spec is decidable and every request item has a unit
No high or medium plan finding remains open
